bsc_off_control: Service stopped, /dev/bsc-target0 absent, GPIO18/19 input. Level-only READY toggles still reproduced write EREMOTEIO. Original service restored afterwards.
controller_irq_control: GPIO22 unclaimed input with pull-up. 100 READY level cycles with no bus traffic produced no GPIO IRQ counter increments.
scope_limit: The direction test hook confirmed Stop, but bulk waveform export timed out; subsequent rearm attempt left scope Ready. Original earlier paired-failure waveforms remain preserved in fair-pqc evidence.
interpretation: The connected-disconnected-reconnected level-toggle comparison fails after 8 successful echoes, passes all 500 (1,449,901 payload bytes over 7,153 GPIO cycles), then fails after 67 successful echoes (674 GPIO cycles). The reconnected request-write failure has EREMOTEIO (121) and an 11 us lock wait. The failures track the connected READY path in this finite reproduction. Wire coupling, controller pad/input, and ground/probe effects remain unresolved; this does not qualify concurrent authenticated PQC traffic.

gpio_drive_controls.direction: GPIO17 output-low/input toggling emulates the original open-drain electrical states; never actively drives high.
gpio_drive_controls.level: GPIO17 remains output and is driven high/low (push-pull diagnostic, unlike the original open-drain release-high mode).
gpio_drive_controls.high-direction: GPIO17 switches between input and output-high; logically stays high.
gpio_drive_controls.rewrite: Repeated output-mode writes leave direction and level unchanged.

interpretation_limit: The BSC-disabled level control uses push-pull edges. It demonstrates a peripheral-independent failure in this setup, but cannot by itself prove an identical electrical mechanism to the original open-drain publication edge.

disconnected_control.electrical_check: Controller GPIO22 stays high with target GPIO17 driven low.
disconnected_control.bsc_state: Peer service active but idle; RX/TX transactions and bytes remain zero after restart.
disconnected_control.pulse_mode: Fixed-output high/low, matching connected level control.
disconnected_control.probe_retention: C3 target-side retention requested, not independently verified.
disconnected_control.cleanup: Pulse and temporary connector inactive, GPIO17 input, SDA/SCL ALT3; original service PIDs intact.

reconnected_control.electrical_check: Controller GPIO22 follows target GPIO17 low after reconnection; returns high after release.
reconnected_control.bsc_state: Peer HSM remains idle; RX/TX transactions and bytes remain zero.
reconnected_control.pulse_mode: Same fixed-output high/low pulses, seed 91, up to 500 echoes.
reconnected_control.cleanup: Pulse generator and temporary connector inactive; GPIO17 input/high; SDA/SCL ALT3; original service PIDs intact.

next_discriminating_control: Retest with a short READY/ground pair routed away from SDA/SCL; if failures remain, move READY to a spare controller GPIO to separate routing from pad/input effects.

scope_final_state.record: Existing retained acquisition; the disconnected/reconnected tests did not arm or capture a new time-aligned waveform.
